answer: Builder's take: an escalating registration burn keyed to a funding anchor. Each new ID's gas is traced back 3 hops; the earliest shared wallet is its anchor. The first ID per anchor burns 10 tokens and each extra one doubles (10, 20, 40...; proposed, unmeasured), so a 50-clone farm would burn ~1.1e16. Fees turn to ember, not treasury income, so no one profits from admitting farms. Fresh wallets forming an island with no history pay a flat 40 until 10 epochs of outside transactions link them.
